game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Bone Valley Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Bone Valley, a valley of bleached bones: the sand ranger must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bone Valley: a valley of bleached bones
core_gameplay_loop: In Bone Valley, repeat each round: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script. Each round, mirage spirits strike the camel pen, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the autopsy value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the camel pen from mirage spirits in Bone Valley: keep the autopsy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: autopsy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 1 (intro tier): Off By One Autopsy
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how autopsy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mirage spirits in Bone Valley.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while autopsy > 0.
